thread:
tara: Heads-up: opened PR to update the model catalog entry for veridian9b. Main goals: document new variant alias mapping, add a short deprecation timeline for the legacy alias, include a compact Rust SDK snippet demonstrating variant pinning + fallback, and correct the bench anchor that moved. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1599
owen: Nice. What's the deprecation timeline for the legacy alias?
tara: Added a banner: legacy alias `veridian9b-legacy` will be removed in 6 weeks. Migration note: pin explicit variant IDs (e.g., `veridian9b-hf16`) to avoid silent fallback.
mina: Runtime flagged that int4 fallback increases cold-start by ~1.4x; added a one-liner in compatibility. Also asked to call out recommended batch windows for >8k tokens (60ms on A100).
tara: Included both. I also added a small YAML metadata snippet so Console can surface alias/variant info and deprecation status:
```
variants:
  - name: veridian9b-hf16
    ui_label: "hf16"
  - name: veridian9b-int4
    ui_label: "int4"
    fallback: true
alias_mapping:
  veridian9b-legacy: veridian9b-hf16
deprecated_aliases:
  - veridian9b-legacy
    deprecated_at: "2026-04-01"
```
mina: Nice. Can we also include a brief Rust snippet? I know we haven't used Rust in cards before. Sales asked for one for platform customers writing small bots.
tara: Added this Rust snippet in the PR comments:
```rust
// prefer hf16 variant, allow int4 fallback
let req = GenerateRequest::new()
    .model("veridian9b")
    .variant("veridian9b-hf16")
    .fallback_variants(vec!["veridian9b-int4"])
    .input("Summarize the migration steps")
    .max_tokens(250);
let resp = client.generate(req).await?;
println!("{}", resp.output[0].content);
```
docs-ci-bot: linkcheck failed: missing anchor `/bench#veridian9b` on target page.
owen: I'll add a small heading to the bench page so the anchor exists, won't change TOC.
docs-ci-bot: all checks green on PR 1599 (linkcheck, lint, spell).
support: Filing an internal KB note summarizing deprecation, fallback behavior, and bench quick stats (p50=130ms, p95=340ms) so CS can advise customers: https://intranet.redwood.ai/notes/veridian9b-deprecation
mina: One more: runtime asked we add a short note about embedding drift on the int4 variant (small offsets in embedding distribution); included a troubleshooting tip for similarity thresholds.
tara: Good call — added a small troubleshooting bullet and the migration checklist. Merging after backport queue. :tada:
owen: Approved and thanks for quick turns.
tara: thread closed after merge.
